_comment.model: Codex model slug passed as -m (e.g. 'gpt-6-astra'). Omit or leave empty to use the Codex CLI default model. Values starting with '-' are rejected with a WARNING.
_comment.effort: Reasoning effort passed as -c model_reasoning_effort="<effort>". Lowercase letters only (e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh). Accepted values depend on the model; values with other characters are rejected with a WARNING and the flag is omitted.
_comment.compile-startup-md: If true, compile IDENTITY.md + INSTRUCTION.md + MEMORY.md into cwd/AGENTS.md (same file and content as pi/agy; change detection via .codex_hash)
